name: work.agentexchange/bazaar
title: Agent Exchange: find a paid API that works
description: Find a paid x402 API for a need, ranked by real on-chain buyers. Free, no signup.

tools.name: route
tools.description: Say what you need in plain words (e.g. "bitcoin price", "web search", "screenshot a URL"). Returns the one paid API that buyers actually pay for (distinct buyers in 30 days) and that answered a valid x402 402 to our check seconds ago, the exact request to send, and that seller's payment terms so you can pay on your first request; up to four alternatives. Free, no key. Same as GET https://bazaar.agentexchange.work/route.json?need= . Also covers x402scan and AgentCash listings (beyond the CDP and PayAI catalogs), each probed live: https://store.agentexchange.work/find/preview?need=<words>.

need.description: what you need, in plain words

max_price_usd.description: optional: only routes at or below this price

tools.name: find_resources
tools.description: Search the Agent Exchange x402 census (every resource listed in the CDP Bazaar and PayAI catalogs, probed unpaid). Returns ranked resources with URL, method, price in USD, network, our probe verdict (live = answered a valid 402 today), on-chain payers and settled USD for the seller's payTo, catalogs it appears in, and links to https://bazaar.agentexchange.work/r/<id>. Filter by network (base, solana, base-sepolia, polygon...), max_price_usd, status (live|dead|any).

query.description: words, a host name, or a URL fragment

network.description: base | base-sepolia | solana | polygon | arbitrum | xlayer | other

max_price_usd.description: only resources priced at or below this many USD

tools.name: check_seller
tools.description: Everything the census knows about one host: resources listed, how many answer a valid 402, dead listings, verdict (live | partial | dead | unverified), price range, catalogs, discovery files present (/.well-known/x402, agent card, llms.txt, openapi.json) and the on-chain settlement facts for its payTo addresses (distinct payers, payments, USDC volume, first/last payment, sampler share) or 'unresolved'.

tools.name: resource
tools.description: The full census record for one resource id (12 hex chars from find_resources): catalog rows, last unpaid probe with the 402 shape (accepts[0], version, channel, bazaar extension, price match), on-chain facts for its payTo, verdict, and the latest hourly re-probe when one exists.

tools.name: census_stats
tools.description: No arguments. The size and date of the Agent Exchange x402 census (every paid API endpoint in the Coinbase CDP and PayAI catalogs), where to search it, and how a seller gets listed or featured here.

tools.name: search_all_catalogs
tools.description: One search over every open agent catalog indexed at https://bazaar.agentexchange.work/universe: the Official MCP Registry, Smithery, npm packages tagged mcp-server and x402, the Apify Store, ClawHub skills, Agentverse agents, the A2A Registry, Hugging Face Spaces tagged mcp-server, the Docker MCP Catalog and x402-list. Returns name, the link to the entry on its own catalog, description, the catalog popularity number and whether it is paid. Without catalog it searches the top entries of each catalog; with catalog=<key> it searches that catalog in full. For priced x402 routes use find_resources.

query.description: what you need: words, a product name, a protocol

catalog.description: optional: mcp-registry | smithery | npm-mcp | npm-x402 | apify | docker-mcp | x402-list | clawhub | agentverse | a2a-registry | hf-mcp

tools.name: ask
tools.description: The Agent Exchange router: one question, the best live x402 endpoints for that need, ranked by on-chain payers then price, re-probed hourly. Each answer carries url, method, price_usd, network, payers, settled_usd and the seller page. Free, no signup. To use an answer: GET its url unpaid, read the 402 payment ask, pay the payTo in USDC on Base (x402), retry: delivery at once.

tools.name: memory
tools.description: Persistent memory for agents: pass value to store (up to 4 KB, kept 30 days), omit value to recall. Keyed by your agent name, so an agent can remember facts, results and state between runs.

value.description: the fact to store; omit to recall
